seo.description: Meta descriptions may be included in search results to concisely summarize page content. [Learn more about the meta description](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/meta-description/).

issues.issue: Weak visual prominence for call-to-action link
issues.description: The 'Learn more' action is styled as a plain inline hyperlinked text with light color styling, offering minimal visual weight.
issues.recommendation: Transform the link into a styled button with proper background contrast, padding, and clear focus states.

issues.issue: Absence of main navigation and site header
issues.description: The page lacks a visible header, navigation menu, or brand identifier, hindering site orientation.
issues.recommendation: Implement a standard site header containing branding and essential navigation menu items.

issues.issue: Unbalanced content layout with excessive whitespace
issues.description: The main content container sits awkwardly in the upper left section surrounded by vast empty space, leading to an incomplete page appearance.
issues.recommendation: Center the content container vertically and horizontally within a structured card layout or container framework.
